subject: DJURÖ 4:147

gate_dependency.closed_by: 10 receipted 1 m DTM tiles re-verified by sha256 against .runtime/receipts before any pixel was read; the parcel mask derived from them measures 5155.0 m2 against 5156.3 m2 registered, an independent check that the boundary and DTM frames align.

licence: Användningsvillkor för värdefulla datamängder (HVD open data), CC BY 4.0
method: Windowed bilinear sample of the receipted 1 m DTM; Horn 3x3 slope/aspect at the pin; least-squares plane and per-cell gradient distribution over the registered parcel mask; heights relative to the site-pin datum for the local ENU heightfield.

coordinate_anchor.cross_checked_against: parcel mask area from this DTM vs Lantmäteriet registered area (5156.3 m2)

provenance_qa.conclusion: NOT CHECKED. The per-tile ursprung/brytgeometri provenance polygons were not downloaded for this site (see the runtime receipt's not_checked line), so the laser-scan epoch behind these cells has not been established. Tile integrity IS verified; provenance is not.

coverage_qa.note: Full coverage: every heightfield vertex sampled a real DTM cell.

plot_footprint.note: Elevations sampled at the AUTHORITATIVE Lantmäteriet registered boundary vertices, not an indicative trace.

sightline_profile.azimuth_basis: mid-bearing of the computed sea-view arc 319.0°–117.0°
sightline_profile.note: Real terrain descent toward the water. Confirms elevation and fall only; it does NOT prove an unobstructed sightline. The visibility question is answered separately in sea-view-derived-v0.1.json, and that answer is a bare-earth upper bound. A rendered horizon is never a view claim.

heightfield.height_reference: RH2000 minus site-pin datum (relative metres, up positive)

not_checked: Per-tile ursprung/brytgeometri provenance; laser point cloud; registered levelling marks; any bathymetry. Heights are bare earth: no buildings, no vegetation.
access_basis: Geotorget order 2026-08-18, kundnr 30056732, avgift 0.00 SEK (same grant used for Svärtinge)
coordinate_frame: LOCAL_ENU x=EAST z=NORTH, origin = site pin (E0,N0 SWEREF99TM)

whole_parcel_plane.method: least-squares plane fit over all in-parcel DTM cells
whole_parcel_plane.answers: which way the parcel as a whole falls

local_ground_slope.method: per-cell gradient of the 1 m grid, distribution over in-parcel cells
local_ground_slope.answers: how steep the ground underfoot actually is

parcel_slope.verdict: NO SINGLE SLOPE DESCRIBES THIS PARCEL. The whole-parcel plane falls 3.9deg toward NE, but the ground underfoot has a median gradient of 8.3deg and reaches 23.8deg across the steepest tenth. The plane fit leaves 1.46 m RMS residual against 11.53 m of relief. This is broken ground - rock shelves and hollows - not a uniform hillside. Quote the fall direction for orientation and the per-cell distribution for steepness; quoting any single slope alone materially understates the site.
parcel_slope.reconciliation_with_pin_slope: These figures do NOT contradict slope_aspect_at_pin. That field is the Horn 3x3 gradient in the single 3 m window around the site pin - the same measure the Svartinge template publishes - and it is a local microslope. The plane fit here is the whole 5155 m2 parcel. Three different questions, three correct answers: at the pin the ground tilts gently WNW; across the parcel it falls NE to the water; underfoot the median gradient is steeper than either. Quote the one that matches the question being asked, and never present one as a correction of another.

limitations: A rendered horizon in any image built from this heightfield is NEVER a view claim; the only view figure is the viewshed in sea-view-derived-v0.1.json.
Heights are Lantmäteriet's 1 m ground model (markhöjdmodell), RH2000. It is a bare-earth model: buildings and vegetation are removed, so these are ground heights, not roof or canopy heights.
Two slope measures are reported because they answer different questions and can disagree. Read parcel_slope.verdict before quoting either one.
This is a derivation from a verified source, not an official terrain survey, and it is not finished-floor or foundation input.
